# Third-party code

Copied as-is so the page needs no build step. Update by bumping the version in `package.json`, running `npm install`, and copying the file again.

| Folder | Package | Version | Licence | Copied file |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sortablejs/` | [SortableJS](https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable) | 1.15.7 (pinned in package.json) | MIT | `node_modules/sortablejs/modular/sortable.esm.js` |
